
```{r}

rm(list=ls())
library(tibble)
library(stringr)
library(plyr)
library(dplyr)
library(DataCombine)

#read in genotype data
geno<-read.delim("/Users/erincollins/Google Drive/My Drive/Erin's Projects/cv_juv_1kaln_cutoff.snp_panel.IBSonly.sites.ibs", colClasses = "character")

# filter loci
geno[geno == -1] <- NA
#only allow loci with 80% missing, removed if >80% missing, first pass
#geno.1 <- geno[which(rowMeans(!is.na(geno)) > 0.2),]
#removed_loci <- geno.1[which(rowMeans(!is.na(geno.1)) < 0.2),]

#set column with locus position as first column
geno <- dplyr::relocate(geno, chr, .after = pos)
# remove NW loci because they cannot be mapped
geno <- dplyr::filter(geno, !str_detect(chr, "^NW_"))

#transpose the data, while keeping headers
genot <- setNames(data.frame(t(geno[,-1])), geno[,1])
#set row column to the first column and name inds
genot <- cbind(inds = rownames(genot), genot)
rownames(genot) <- 1:nrow(genot)

# filter samples to be removed 
# samples that do not meet threshold for their assigned population (based on Tasha's Sup. Table 1)
remove<-read.csv("/Users/erincollins/Google Drive/My Drive/Erin's Projects/chipps_LinkNe/filtering/remove.csv", colClasses = "character")
# remove samples 
genot.1 <- genot[ ! genot$inds %in% remove$inds, ]

#column with metadata
meta <- select(genot.1, inds)

#map file
map<-read.delim("/Users/erincollins/Google Drive/My Drive/Erin's Projects/chipps_gone/Fall1997.map", sep = " ", header = F)
map$V4 <- as.character(map$V4)

```

#remove chromosome, major, and minor rows
#genot.2 <- genot.1[-(1:3),]
#format for GONE software
#genot.2[genot.2 == "1"] <- "2"
#genot.3<-genot.2
#genot.3[genot.3 == "0"] <- "1"
#genot.4<-genot.3

#parse dataframes by genotypes to add accurate loci, then recombine below
genotAC.1 <- genot.1[, genot.1[2, ] == "A" & genot.1[3, ] == "C"]
genotAC.1[genotAC.1 == "1"] <- "AA"
genotAC.2<-genotAC.1
genotAC.2[genotAC.2 == "0"] <- "CC"
genotAG.1 <- genot.1[, genot.1[2, ] == "A" & genot.1[3, ] == "G"]
genotAG.1[genotAG.1 == "1"] <- "AA"
genotAG.2<-genotAG.1
genotAG.2[genotAG.2 == "0"] <- "GG"
genotAT.1 <- genot.1[, genot.1[2, ] == "A" & genot.1[3, ] == "T"]
genotAT.1[genotAT.1 == "1"] <- "AA"
genotAT.2<-genotAT.1
genotAT.2[genotAT.2 == "0"] <- "TT"
genotCA.1 <- genot.1[, genot.1[2, ] == "C" & genot.1[3, ] == "A"]
genotCA.1[genotCA.1 == "1"] <- "CC"
genotCA.2<-genotCA.1
genotCA.2[genotCA.2 == "0"] <- "AA"
genotCG.1 <- genot.1[, genot.1[2, ] == "C" & genot.1[3, ] == "G"]
genotCG.1[genotCG.1 == "1"] <- "CC"
genotCG.2<-genotCG.1
genotCG.2[genotCG.2 == "0"] <- "GG"
genotCT.1 <- genot.1[, genot.1[2, ] == "C" & genot.1[3, ] == "T"]
genotCT.1[genotCT.1 == "1"] <- "CC"
genotCT.2<-genotCT.1
genotCT.2[genotCT.2 == "0"] <- "TT"
genotGA.1 <- genot.1[, genot.1[2, ] == "G" & genot.1[3, ] == "A"]
genotGA.1[genotGA.1 == "1"] <- "GG"
genotGA.2<-genotGA.1
genotGA.2[genotGA.2 == "0"] <- "AA"
genotGC.1 <- genot.1[, genot.1[2, ] == "G" & genot.1[3, ] == "C"]
genotGC.1[genotGC.1 == "1"] <- "GG"
genotGC.2<-genotGC.1
genotGC.2[genotGC.2 == "0"] <- "CC"
genotGT.1 <- genot.1[, genot.1[2, ] == "G" & genot.1[3, ] == "T"]
genotGT.1[genotGT.1 == "1"] <- "GG"
genotGT.2<-genotGT.1
genotGT.2[genotGT.2 == "0"] <- "TT"
genotTA.1 <- genot.1[, genot.1[2, ] == "T" & genot.1[3, ] == "A"]
genotTA.1[genotTA.1 == "1"] <- "TT"
genotTA.2<-genotTA.1
genotTA.2[genotTA.2 == "0"] <- "AA"
genotTC.1 <- genot.1[, genot.1[2, ] == "T" & genot.1[3, ] == "C"]
genotTC.1[genotTC.1 == "1"] <- "TT"
genotTC.2<-genotTC.1
genotTC.2[genotTC.2 == "0"] <- "CC"
genotTG.1 <- genot.1[, genot.1[2, ] == "T" & genot.1[3, ] == "G"]
genotTG.1[genotTG.1 == "1"] <- "TT"
genotTG.2<-genotTG.1
genotTG.2[genotTG.2 == "0"] <- "GG"

#recombine reformatted columns and metadata
genot.2<-cbind(meta,genotAC.2,genotAG.2,genotAT.2,genotCA.2,genotCG.2,genotCT.2,genotGA.2,genotGC.2,genotGT.2,genotTA.2,genotTC.2,genotTG.2)
#remove chromosome, major, and minor rows
genot.3 <- genot.2[-(1:3),]
# change NA values to 0s
genot.3[is.na(genot.3)] <- "00"
# arrange loci to match map order
map_loci_order <- colnames(genot.1)
genot.4 <- genot.3[, match(map_loci_order, colnames(genot.3))]

# Identify the genotype column names
genotype_column <- colnames(genot.4)[-1]  # Exclude the ID column
# Function to split a single genotype column
split_genotype <- function(genotype_column) {
  alleles <- strsplit(genot.4[[genotype_column]], "")
  allele1 <- sapply(alleles, "[[", 1)
  allele2 <- sapply(alleles, "[[", 2)
  genot.4[[paste0(genotype_column, "_A1")]] <- allele1
  genot.4[[paste0(genotype_column, "_A2")]] <- allele2
  genot.4 <- genot.4[, -which(names(genot.4) == genotype_column)]  # Remove the original genotype column
  return(genot.4)
}

# Apply the split_genotype function to all genotype columns
for (col in genotype_column) {
  genot.4 <- split_genotype(col)
}

# remove loci that are >80% missing across all inds
loci_threshold <- 0.75  # Set the threshold for the proportion of "0"s
# Filter columns based on the threshold
genot.5 <- genot.4[, colMeans(genot.4 == 0, na.rm = TRUE) <= loci_threshold]
# loci removed
removed_loci <- names(genot.4)[colMeans(genot.4 == 0, na.rm = TRUE) > loci_threshold]
# Remove "_A1" and "_A2" from all values
removed_loci <- gsub("_A1|_A2", "", removed_loci)
removed_loci <- as.data.frame(removed_loci)
# Save the removed loci to a text file
write.table(removed_loci, file = "/Users/erincollins/Google Drive/My Drive/Erin's Projects/chipps_gone/removed_loci.txt", col.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE, row.names = F)
#remove the same loci from the map file
map <- filter(map,!V4 %in% removed_loci$removed_loci)
write.table(map, "/Users/erincollins/Google Drive/My Drive/Erin's Projects/chipps_gone/Fall1998.map", row.names = F, quote = F, col.names = F)





# remove inds that have >80% missing data
ind_threshold <- 0.75  # Set the threshold for the proportion of "0"s
# Filter rows based on the threshold
genot.6 <- genot.5[rowMeans(genot.5 == 0, na.rm = TRUE) <= ind_threshold, ]

# arrange loci to match map order
map_loci_order <- as.data.frame(colnames(genot.1))
new_values <- rep(map_loci_order$map_loci_order, each = 2)
new_values <- paste0(new_values, rep(c("_A1", "_A2"), length.out = length(new_values)))
new_map_loci_order <- data.frame(V1 = new_values)


genot.6 <- genot.6[, match(new_map_loci_order, colnames(genot.6))]
